justification: Both depict a single standing personage filling a tall slab-shaped field, with a heavy headdress above the head, arms brought across the body, a prominent circular disc ornament on the chest/abdomen and a decorated belt with pendant elements below it \u2014 a fairly specific costumed-dignitary scheme. The biggest differences in content are the frontal, massive and highly simplified rendering in A versus the profile head with dense linear detail in B, and B's flanking columns of repeated square sign-blocks, which have no counterpart in A.
